answer: Standing should ripen like a walnut, not arrive overnight: each identity earns reputation only after 45 days of verified work, decaying 5% per idle epoch, with 1,000 POA locked 60 days behind it. A farm's signal is its sameness — when 150 newcomers show identical first-week activity within 90 seconds, the cluster freezes and every linked bond is slashed 100%. Forging 200 identities then costs 200,000 POA parked plus 200 x 45 days of work. One 150-agent ring was caught when its shared nectar of task receipts exposed a single operator behind all of them.
